description: This Java class RpmModel provides a data model for RPM readings, including smoothing logic to prevent rapid UI updates when RPM changes are within a 5% threshold. It updates its value based on sensor input and notifies registered listeners on changes.

classes.name: RpmModel
classes.description: Singleton class providing RPM data with smoothing capabilities for UI display, and listener management for changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RpmModel.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the current RPM value and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getSmoothedValue
methods.description: Returns the RPM value with smoothing applied to prevent rapid UI updates.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when RPM changes.
